title: Sets Exercises
explanation: Pon a prueba tus conocimientos sobre Sets resolviendo estos ejercicios.

exercises.question: Check if 'apple' is present in the fruits set.
Use the add method to add 'orange' to the fruits set.
Use the correct method to add multiple items (more_fruits) to the fruits set.
Use the remove method to remove 'banana' from the fruits set.
Use the discard method to remove 'banana' from the fruits set.
